run_strip_asm_cli: run strip_asm.py with an input assembly file path and output file path to generate a stripped assembly file
process_asm_strip_directives: process an assembly string to strip unwanted directives, comments, and global declarations using process_asm
transform_labels_remove_unused: transform assembly labels by normalizing them and removing unused local label declarations using transform_labels
process_identifiers_normalize_macho: process identifiers in an assembly line to normalize Mach-O underscore prefixes for cross-platform consistency
find_used_labels_jumps: find all used local labels referenced by jump instructions in assembly code using find_used_labels
